description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB with its LiLiCorr speculative drafter, using MiaAI-Lab native TensorFold at eea9dc9c (v1.1.6) plus the Bolt engine and patch 0002. Sixteen streams, a 262,144-token window, BF16 KV and an 8 GiB prompt cache. Supports images and video through the RADIO tower. The estimated 80 GiB peak includes target/drafter weights, 32 GiB of full-window KV, recurrent state per stream, vision workspace and runtime overhead. Physical performance and quality are unmeasured here. The kit pin is MiaAI-Lab's current head, which names TensorFold v1.1.6 (lazy Mamba state, Q8_0 drafter projections and FP4 prompt projections by default, all on here as the kit's defaults). The creator has published no image for it, so this recipe builds the creator's exact engine commit (TensorFold eea9dc9c, the kit's patches and libbolt sources, Zig 0.17.0, the same CUDA base) and scans the build for sm_121 kernels.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt LiLiCorr TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
